units.source_text: 從那以後，每當勞埃德的電影在這個小鎮上演時，我是每場必看，並悄悄地琢磨和研究他的表情。

en.t: From then on, whenever Lloyd's films were shown in this town, I made sure to see every one, secretly pondering and studying his expressions.

units.source_text: 還有一次，在某個秋日的夜晚，我正躺在床上看書，大姐像飛鳥一樣跑進我的房間，突然趴在我的被子上哭起來。

en.t: Another time, on an autumn night, as I lay in bed reading, my elder sister darted into my room like a bird, suddenly flung herself onto my quilt, and began to cry.
"Yo-chan, you will save me, won't you? You will, won't you?

units.source_text: 這樣的家，我們還不如一起離開了好呢。

en.t: We would be better off leaving a house like this together.
Save me, save me," and so on.

units.source_text: 她的嘴激烈地傾訴著，接著又開始哭起來。

en.t: She poured out those fierce words, and then began crying again.

units.source_text: 不過，我並不是第一次目睹女人這樣的態度，

en.t: However, this was not the first time I had witnessed such behavior from a woman,

units.source_text: 所以對大姐的激烈言辭並不吃驚，

en.t: so I was not surprised by my elder sister's fierce words,

units.source_text: 相反，倒是對她陳腐空洞的話感到乏味與掃興。

en.t: on the contrary, I found her stale, empty words tedious and dispiriting.
